combobox.Arrow.summary: Displays an element positioned against the anchor.

combobox.Backdrop.summary: An overlay displayed beneath the popup.

combobox.Chip.summary: An individual chip that represents a value in a multiselectable input.

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

combobox.ChipRemove.summary: A button to remove a chip.

combobox.Chips.summary: A container for the chips in a multiselectable input.

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

props.doc: Whether the component should remain mounted in the DOM when not visible.
props.name: keepMounted

combobox.Collection.summary: Doesn't render its own HTML element.

combobox.Empty.summary: Requires the `items` prop on the root component.

props.doc: Items to be rendered within this group. When provided, child `Collection` components will use these items.
props.name: items

combobox.Group.summary: Groups related items with the corresponding label.

combobox.GroupLabel.summary: An accessible label that is automatically associated with its parent group.

combobox.Icon.summary: An icon that indicates that the trigger button opens the popup.

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

combobox.Input.summary: A text input to search for items in the list.

combobox.InputGroup.summary: A wrapper for the input and its associated controls.

props.doc: A unique value that identifies this item.
props.name: value

props.doc: An optional click handler for the item when selected. It fires when clicking the item with the pointer, as well as when pressing `Enter` with the keyboard if the item is highlighted when the `Input` or `List` element has focus.
props.name: onClick

props.doc: The index of the item in the list. Improves performance when specified by avoiding the need to calculate the index automatically from the DOM.
props.name: index

props.doc: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.
props.name: nativeButton

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

combobox.Item.summary: An individual item in the list.

props.doc: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM when the item is not selected.
props.name: keepMounted

combobox.ItemIndicator.summary: Indicates whether the item is selected.

combobox.Label.summary: An accessible label that is automatically associated with the combobox trigger.

combobox.List.summary: A list container for the items.

props.doc: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.
props.name: keepMounted

combobox.Portal.summary: A portal element that moves the popup to a different part of the DOM.

props.doc: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.
props.name: disableAnchorTracking

props.doc: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.
props.name: align

props.doc: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.
props.name: side

props.doc: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.
props.name: arrowPadding

props.doc: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`).`'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within the clipping boundary so it stays visible.`'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows.`'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the alignment axis to fit.`'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the preferred axis cannot fit: `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR).`'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR).`'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`. If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.
props.name: collisionAvoidance

props.doc: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.
props.name: collisionBoundary

props.doc: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.
props.name: collisionPadding

props.doc: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.
props.name: sticky

combobox.Positioner.summary: Positions the popup against the trigger.

props.doc: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.
props.name: name

props.doc: Event handler called when the input value changes.
props.name: onInputValueChange

props.doc: Whether the popup is initially open. To render a controlled popup, use the `open` prop instead.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.doc: Whether the popup is currently open. Use when controlled.
props.name: open

props.doc: Event handler called when the popup is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.doc: Whether the first matching item is highlighted automatically while filtering.
props.name: autoHighlight

props.doc: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.
props.name: highlightItemOnHover

props.doc: Provides a hint to the browser for autofill.
props.name: autoComplete
filter
props.type: ((itemValue: Value, query: string, itemToString?: ((itemValue: Value) => string)) => boolean) \

props.doc: Identifies the form that owns the internal input. Useful when the combobox is rendered outside the form.
props.name: form

props.doc: Whether list items are presented in a grid layout. When enabled, arrow keys navigate across rows and columns inferred from DOM rows.
props.name: grid

props.doc: Whether the list is rendered inline without using the component's own popup. Specify `open` unconditionally in conjunction with this prop so the list is considered visible: `<Combobox.Root inline open>` In a `Combobox.Root` > `Dialog.Root` composition, bind the Combobox's `open` and `onOpenChange` props to the `Dialog`'s `open` and `onOpenChange` state instead so the component resets its transient state (filter query, highlighted item, and input value) when the dialog closes.
props.name: inline

props.doc: Custom comparison logic used to determine if a combobox item value matches the current selected value. Useful when item values are objects without matching referentially. Defaults to `Object.is` comparison.
props.name: isItemEqualToValue

props.doc: When the item values are objects (`<Combobox.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for display in the input. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the label will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.
props.name: itemToStringLabel

props.doc: When the item values are objects (`<Combobox.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for form submission. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the value will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.
props.name: itemToStringValue

props.doc: The maximum number of items to display in the list.
props.name: limit

props.doc: The locale to use for string comparison. Defaults to the user's runtime locale.
props.name: locale

props.doc: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the input when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys. The first item can then be reached by pressing ArrowDown again from the input, or the last item can be reached by pressing ArrowUp from the input. The input is always included in the focus loop per [ARIA Authoring Practices](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/). When disabled, focus does not move when on the last element and the user presses ArrowDown, or when on the first element and the user presses ArrowUp.
props.name: loopFocus

props.doc: Determines if the popup enters a modal state when open. `true`: user interaction is limited to the popup: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.`false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.
props.name: modal

props.doc: Whether multiple items can be selected.
props.name: multiple

props.doc: Event handler called after any animations complete when the popup is opened or closed.
props.name: onOpenChangeComplete

props.doc: Whether the popup opens when clicking the input.
props.name: openOnInputClick

props.doc: Whether the items are being externally virtualized.
props.name: virtualized

props.doc: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
props.name: disabled

props.doc: Whether the user should be unable to choose a different option from the popup.
props.name: readOnly

props.doc: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.
props.name: required

props.doc: A ref to the hidden input element.
props.name: inputRef
